description: Header file defining the CyclicBuffer class for shared process boundary data sharing, including buffer management, locking, and cursor operations.

classes.name: CyclicBuffer
classes.description: A class for managing a process-wide shared cyclic buffer with locking, reading, writing, and cursor operations.

classes.name: CyclicBuffer::Cursor
classes.description: A nested class providing cursor-based read operations within the cyclic buffer.

methods.name: CyclicBuffer
methods.description: Constructors for initializing the cyclic buffer with file or buffer object.

methods.name: Overwritten
methods.description: Checks if the buffer has been overwritten.

methods.name: ErrorCode
methods.description: Returns the error code from the buffer.

methods.name: IsLocked
methods.description: Checks if the buffer is locked.

methods.name: LockPid
methods.description: Returns the process ID holding the lock.

methods.name: IsOverwrite
methods.description: Checks if overwrite mode is active.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the buffer is valid.

methods.name: Used
methods.description: Returns the amount of used space.

methods.name: Free
methods.description: Returns the amount of free space.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Returns the total size of the buffer.

methods.name: Lock
methods.description: Locks the buffer for access, optionally waiting.
